descricao_original: A higher magnification of an efferent duct shows its columnar epithelium, composed of tall and short cells, some with cilia and some with lysosomes. The variation in height imparts a scallopy border diagnostic for these tubules. The numerous lysosomes absorb and break down testicular fluid, while cilia help propel sperm through these tubules. 400x
